title: Account Settings
subtitle: Your personal identity on HyperCool — separate from any single workspace's settings.
noEmailHint: Add a verified email to enable logging in with it and recovering access later.
deliveredNote: A real verification link was sent to this address.
notDeliveredNote: The email could not actually be sent right now — try again later or contact your system owner.
passwordHint: To change your password, use "Forgot password?" from the login page — this requires a verified email.
passwordNoEmailHint: Add a verified email first so you can recover your password yourself in the future.

banner.text: Add your email to secure your account and enable access recovery.

recovery.forgotHint: Enter your verified email and we'll send a password reset link if an account exists for it.
recovery.resetHint: Choose a new password for your account.
recovery.resetSuccessBody: You can now log in with your new password. Every other session for your account has been ended.
